Chapter 5: Tools & Environment Used

5.1 Hardware and Software Requirements

The AssetDesk engineering platform leverages modern web standards, an asynchronous runtime, and a document database. Environment specifications are partitioned into verified software dependency versions, physical workstation profiles, and architectural layer technologies.

5.2 Server-Side and Client-Side Tooling Architecture

AssetDesk strictly decouples the client application from the backend API server. Communication occurs exclusively over stateless HTTP/JSON interfaces. Figures 5.1 and 5.2 depict the 3-tier logical architecture and production deployment layout across full-width diagrams.

Presentation (React SPA), Application (Node.js/Express REST API controllers), and Data Layer (MongoDB Atlas with B-Tree indexes).
HTTPS edge termination via Vercel Edge CDN, Node.js PM2 process clustering, and TLS connection pooling to MongoDB Atlas.
